entries.description: Backend API for the Undistracted Me new-tab dashboard: curated photo backgrounds, favicon proxy, RSS feed parser, Nepali stock data and Google OAuth token exchange.
representativeQueries: get curated background photos for my dashboard
parse an RSS feed for my news widget

entries.description: Undistracted Me is a free, open-source focus new tab for Chrome and Firefox: a Nepali (Bikram Sambat) calendar, site blocker, Pomodoro timer, ambient sounds, Google Tasks and quiet widgets. No account, works offline.
representativeQueries: what is the Nepali date today
free website blocker with a Pomodoro timer
